zone.name: Zones
zone.hint: Live zones from area templates: automatic, on button, or off.

effect.name: Effects on self and allies
effect.hint: Apply effects and conditions when an item is used.

challenge.name: Challenges
challenge.hint: Auto: NPCs roll immediately on the GM client, player characters by button.

apply.name: Conditions by degree
apply.hint: Apply conditions to targets by challenge result (default: GM button).

reaction.name: Reactions
reaction.hint: Auto: whisper a hint when a reaction changes the attack outcome.

macro.name: Rule macros
macro.hint: Run macros attached to rules, executed by the active GM.

shieldBlock.name: Shield Block reminder
shieldBlock.hint: Auto: whisper a Shield Block button when damage targets a creature with a raised shield and a free reaction; after a block the Shield spell ends.

frightened.name: Frightened each turn
frightened.hint: Auto: frightened drops by 1 at the end of the creature's turn (pf2e does not do it). Yields when the Workbench setting decreaseFrightenedConditionEachTurn is on.

sickened.name: Sickened each turn
sickened.hint: Auto: at the start of a sickened creature's turn, a whisper to the owner and GM with a Retch button (Fortitude vs the source DC).

damageGate.name: Damage by attack outcome
damageGate.hint: Auto: after an attack roll only the matching damage button stays (hit - Damage, critical hit - Critical); misses get none. Strike buttons on the sheet are not covered.

yieldToAutomations.name: Yield to pf2e-automations
yieldToAutomations.hint: Do not run rules for items already covered by an active pf2e-automations group. A rule can override this with its yield field.

useToolbeltTargetHelper.name: Use Toolbelt Target Helper
useToolbeltTargetHelper.hint: If Target Helper is enabled, it makes the challenge rolls instead of this module.

noteMode.name: Affliction note
noteMode.hint: What the module does not automate in an affliction (cannot be removed, death, transformation). Public: in the effect description and on the stage card; GM only: whispered to the GM. Changing it does not affect descriptions of afflictions already applied.

showWindow.name: Show reaction window
showWindow.hint: A small window with Use / Skip buttons when a reaction hint is whispered to you (this client only).

marks.name: Visibility marks in PF2e Vision
marks.hint: When the PF2e Vision module is active, smoke, blindness and invisibility write marks into its matrix instead of conditions on actors.

resumeMinutes.name: Resume window (minutes)
resumeMinutes.hint: Messages older than this are not resumed automatically (1-1440).

debug.name: Debug
debug.hint: Write verbose logs to the console (this client only).
